(5)bla ma rig 'dzin /gyi sgrub pa byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs so/ /(6)rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog/phyogs du rgyal ba'i ranam

tei:div.tei:p: (5)bla ma rig 'dzin /gyi sgrub pa byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs so// (6)rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog /phyogs du rgyal ba'i ranam 'phrul ma lus gar// spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po khyod las su// dpal mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// 'dir rig 'dzin /bla ma sgrub pa la// sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes rnams so// dang po ni/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor khyab bdag he ru ka dpal mgon rig 'dzin /bla ma la// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// hoḥ 'gro ba sems can kun don du// rig 'dzin /bla ma mkhyod sgrubs nas// sangs rgyas pa rmad byung rnams// bdag gis rab tu sgrub par bgyi// hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal

sogs/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ gsang ba sngags kyi da la 'dir// 'du ba'i lha ni ma gtogs pa// lha gzhan rgyu ba'i skabs med na// bgegs phran 'byung po smod ci dgos// hūm̐/ nga ni rdo rje gtum po'i sku// thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo'i tshogs// nam mkha' sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin// kun kyang hūm̐ sgra ti ri ri// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badzra kro dha dzwa la maṇḍal ha la ha la hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ (7)phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐/ ye shes rang snang rdo rje'i gur// chos nyid nam mkha'i dbyings la brdal// rngams pa'i khro tshogs phreng ba khrigs// rdo rje me dpung 'bar bar gyur// badzra dzñā na rakṣa rakṣa bhrum̐// hūm̐/ sku gsum rgyal ba'i pho brang nas// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin /bla ma rnams// thugs rje thugs dam dus la bab// byin chen dbab pa'i dus la bab// sku da thig le me re re// 'ja' 'od zer phreng lam se lam// thugs rje char ltar sha ra ra// byin rlabs na bun thu lu lu// dngos grub char ltar si li la// rig 'dzin /gdung 'tshob bdag cag la// sku gsung thugs kyi byin phob cig gnas dang snang ba thams cad kun// sgyu 'phrul drwa bar byin gyis rlobs// oṃ gu ru sarba dzñā na a be sha ya hūm̐ ha hoḥpheṃ pheṃ dzaḥdzaḥ ho/ rig 'dzin /bla ma'i lha tshogs dgongs// 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar// dgongs pa klong du ma gyur bar// rig 'dus dpal mgon bla ma bsgrub// gsang sngags spyod pa bdag gis bsgrub// byang chub spyod dka' bdag gis spyod// sangs rgyas mdzad (8)sa bdag sgrub na// bdag la dgongs shig byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐/ mchod rdzas kun bzang rol pa'i sprin// phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyis// mchod sprin nam mkha'i 'jam klas gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de dag gi sbyor ba'i chos rdzogs so// āḥ chos rnams mi dmigs mnyam pa nyid// rang byung ye shes rdzogs pa che// ma bcos rnam rtog bral ba'i dbyings// rig stong gnyug ma'i ye shes ni// da lta'i rig pa rjen pa 'di// chos zad chos sku'i bla ma mchog

chos rje bstan pa'i nyi ma ni// dmar smug nyams kyis rnam par sgeg rnal 'byor brtul zhugs rol pa'i chas// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// phyag gnyis ngal bso'i phyag rgya mdzad// spyan gzung dbyings la lta stangs mdzad// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku// a bhā dī pa'i ngo bor bzhugs// thugs kar 'od kyi drwa ba'i klong*// 'bum phrag drug cu'i shing rta mchog 'pho chen sku brnyes bī ma la// ljang ser paṇḍi ta yi tshul// pan zhu chos gos sham thabs gsol// phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag phyag rgya'i steng*// bde stong bdud (9)rtsi'i thod pa 'dzin// snang la rang bzhin med par gsal// rig 'dzin /bla ma'i spyi gtsug tu// ye shes 'od lnga 'khrugs pa'i klong*// chos zad chos sku'i ston pa mchog rigs kyi gtso mchog klong chen pa// dkar dmar zhi 'jug paṇḍi ta// rab byung rdzogs pa'i chas su gsal// mtha' skor 'od lnga'i thig le klong*// 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po yi// rig 'dzin /bla ma yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho rnams// nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigs par gsal// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ༈ hūm̐/ spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nas// chos sku'i bla ma gshegs su gsol// 'gags pa med pa'i zhing khams nas// longs sku'i bla ma gshegs su gsol// gang 'dul sprul pa'i zhing khams nas// sprul sku'i bla ma gshegs su gsol// gnas yul zhing khams rab 'byams nas// brgyud gsum bla ma rig 'dzin /dang*// yi dam zhi khro mkha' 'gro dang*// dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// e hya hi// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ༈ hūm̐/ rang rig don gyi bla ma dang*// ye nas rang dang 'du 'bral med (10)'phrul dga'i lha yi longs spyod bzhin// gnyis med gus pa'i dbyings la 'dud// ༈ hoḥ snang srid dag dang ma dag chos// chos nyid dbyings su thim pa'i rtsal// phyi nang nyer spyod mchod pa'i sprin// 'dod lnga mchod pa'i lnga mo dang*// sman dang rakta ba lingta// sbyor sgrol gnyis med byang chub sems// rig 'dzin

/bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pa ḍyaṃ puṣpe dhuppe ā lo ke gandhe nai bei dya shabta rū pa shabta gandhe ra sa sparshe ma hā a mṛ ta ma hā ba liṃ ta dharma dhartu sarba pū ja hoḥ ༈ hūm̐/ chos sku'i dbyings las longs skur bzhengs// gang 'dul sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul ngoms// dpal ldan yon tan rdzogs pa'i rje// sku gsum bla ma'i tshogs la bstod// yon tan rgya mtsho'i rdul dang mnyam// mthong thos dran rig thams cad kun// byang chub chen po'i dbyings las sbyor// bla ma rig 'dzin /tshogs la bstod// ༈ bi ma'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du skye ba med 'i yi ge āḥdakar po'i mtha' bskor du// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru bi ma la mi tra dzñā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes pas (11)'khor ba'i 'od dang zer las phyi nang snod bcud thams cad sbyongs te dag pa'i zhing du gyur par mos// de nas gsol ba 'dab pa ni/ kyai ma bla ma rin po che// ngan song sgo gcod thugs rje can// thar pa'i lam 'dren bka' drin can// rig pa ngo sprod byin rlabs can// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// ci mdzad khyed mkhyen rin po che// zhes mos gus rtse gcig pas snang grags thams cad bla ma'i rol pa'i blta zhing gsol 'debs kyi tshul du ja bra bzla'o/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma'i gnas gsum 'od zer ni// dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phro ba ni// bdag gi gnas gsum thim pa las// dbang bzhi thob cing sgrib bzhi dag lam bzhi sgom cing gnas skabs kyi// rig 'dzin /rnam bzhi'i 'bras bu thob// mthar thug sku bzhi mngon du gyur// rang rig zung 'jug don gyi sku// ye shes bla ma'i rang zhal blta// a zhes dgongs pa'i rgyun skyong ngo*// des ni dngos gzhi'i rim pa rdzogs// sa ma ya/ rjes rim tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni// dngos 'byor bza' bca' brdung ba dang*// khyad par sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// dza gad phud kyis bran byas te/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ (12)oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bza' dang btung dang bca' ba bgo bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga// ye shes longs spyod bsgrub pa'i rdzas// 'dod yon lha mos nam mkha' gang*// dam tshig mchog gi rdzas su gyur// ༈ hūm̐/ gsang chen sngags kyi da la 'dir// sras bcas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*// rig 'dzin /blal ma gshegs su gsol// sgyu 'phrul ye shes zhi dang kharo// yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsol// gnas yul dur khrod rab 'byams nas// ma sring mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas nas// bka' srung dam can gshegs su gsol// oṃ e hya hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ni badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ hūm̐/ bza' bca' btung ba'i longs spyod tshogs// 'dod yon lha mo mang po 'phro// phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig rdzas// bla ma rig 'dzin /tshogs la'abul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// ༈ hūm̐/ sdom gsum dam tshig nyams pa kun// tshogs kyi 'khor lo la brten nas// nyams pa bshags so bzod pa gsol// (13)dag tshangs dgyes pa'i zhal ras ston// oṃ badzra sogs tshang bar brjod/ hūm̐// bzhengs shig bla ma rig 'dzin /rnams// nga bdag gzung 'dzin /rū tra rnams// phob cig gzir shig rnam par dbye// chings zhing rab tu myos par mjod// brdung shig gtub cig rnam shes spor// snyigs ma tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol// rū tra ma ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ༈ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor mtha' skyongs ma sring rnams// bzhengs shig dur khrod gnas nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// rnal 'byor bsgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig u tstshiṣṭa ba ling ta khā hiḥ ༈ hūm̐// bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam can// bzhengs shig dpal mgon bla ma'i tshogs// bdag cag rjes 'jug rnal 'byor rnams// thugs bskyed thugs rje nus pa yis// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol// gzung 'dzin /nga bdag dbyings su sgrol// chos nyid rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur// nyams rtogs ye shes gong du spor// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// ༈

bhyoḥ bod skyong brtan ma (14)bcu gnyis ni// rang rang rigs kyi 'khor dang bcas// ming po rdo rje bdag 'bod na// sring mo ma thogs myur du byon// 'dir gshegs bshal chu'i gtor ma longs// las bzhi'i phrin las grub par mjod// ༈ hūm̐// mnan no log 'dren dam sri kun// 'bar ba chen po ri rab 'og mnan no nam yang ldang ba med// e waṃ ma ya bzhi yi dbyibs// las bzhi lhun grub bro ra tu// lu gu rgyu du gzer bsdom nas// bcing gyur bskyed pa phyogs bcur 'phro// rig pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzis// brdung ngo dpal gyi bro brdung ngo*// blang ngo ye shes glu blang bas// rnam rtog mtshan ma las byung ba'i// ma rtog rū tra dbyings su non// mā ra ya nan/ st+waṃ bha ya nan/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku gsum byin brlabs sprin phung 'khrigs// bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog dngos grub yid bzhin char bzhin 'bebs pa// yi dam rnams kyi bkra shis shog rnam bzhi'i thogs med glog 'khyugs pa// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog legs nyes stangs 'dzin /phrin las (15)(16)bdag dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog ces pa 'di ni mkhan dam pa tshe dbang rig 'dzin /gyi dgongs bzhed bzhin rang gi dag snang du shar ba la the tshom med par yi ge bgyid pa po ni// theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o/// //
